wifi_issue.title: Wi-Fi Connection Problem
steps: Check whether Wi-Fi is turned on.
Restart your router.
Forget the Wi-Fi network and reconnect.
Restart your device.
Check whether other devices can connect.
Contact your Internet Service Provider if the issue continues.

login_issue.title: Login Problem
steps: Check your username and password.
Reset your password using Forgot Password.
Clear browser cache and cookies.
Try another browser.
Check whether your account is locked.
Contact customer support if login still fails.

app_crash.title: Application Crash
steps: Close the application completely.
Restart your device.
Update the app to the latest version.
Clear app cache.
Check available storage.
Reinstall the app if the crash continues.

payment_issue.title: Payment Failure
steps: Check your internet connection.
Verify card details.
Check bank balance or transaction limit.
Try another payment method.
Wait for a few minutes and retry.
Contact support if money was deducted.
